product_goal: Flagship TapeCore model reproducing the unusually large, authoritative 3M M56 character from measurable machine behavior rather than a generic head-bump preset.

authoritative_anchors.15ips_overbias: 4 dB at 15 kHz for documented 3M heads / 202 or 203 tape alignment procedure
authoritative_anchors.line_output: transformer-coupled 600 ohm, +28 dBm with <1% distortion 30 Hz–15 kHz
authoritative_anchors.linearizer: 3% H3 setup with linearizer off; <0.8% H3 expected with linearizer on

big_sound_hypothesis: Do not equate 'big' with a fixed low-frequency boost.
Test LF magnitude together with phase/group delay and level dependence.
Test transformer output headroom and nonlinear progression separately from tape magnetics.
Test 16-track crosstalk/shared transport behavior and transient recovery.
Use remembered subjective size as listening validation only after objective constraints are met.
commercial_reference_policy: UAD, Pulsar Modular, or other trusted tape products may constrain macroscopic behavior but cannot establish M56 hardware truth.
